brief: Apply the loading reduction in MG-021 from the third day onward for this unit experiencing a sustained event extending beyond 48 hours with overnight minima above 24 degrees, as specified in MG-021. Record every de-rating applied, the reason, the value, and the period in accordance with MG-021. Restore the full rating only when the underlying condition has been corrected and verified, as required by MG-021.
